title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B
summary: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B on one DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB) served natively by gr8 (g6embed + g6front-rs): calibrated exlr8-v2 4-bit trellis (1.33 GB on disk, 2.61 GiB GPU peak, 1.45 s cold boot), 10.6 ms query p50 / 14,568 tok/s at 8 concurrent streams (4.78x faster than BF16 vLLM), -0.0030 mean 15-task delta vs BF16 (0.9906 text / 0.9776 image held-out cosine), full DeepStack vision + Matryoshka (64..2048) on /v1/embeddings.

configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-26 on one NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB, ARM64 64 KiB page kernel, 2200 MHz SM clock cap) with gr8 g6embed + g6front-rs (full 54-file XXH64 checksum verification, CAP=16384, MAX_MODEL_LEN=16384, native mode: 299 Trellis K4 + 1 int4_g32 + 1 FP8_ROW vocab + 1 BF16 pos_embed). Concurrency rows measure live HTTP /v1/embeddings throughput (tokens/s and median request latency) at 1, 8, and 16 concurrent clients (single-item text batch_1 hits 10.87 ms / 92.0 items/s / 4,782 tok/s, 4.78x faster than BF16 vLLM). 32-item multimodal suite p50: 15.51 ms overall (10.59 ms instructed query, 10.40 ms raw text).
